svg.title: Architecture and full contribution calendar
svg.desc: Black and dirty-gold portfolio architecture: Commitment Theory through MO§ES to SignalAF, AQUA and Signomy, followed by the full 53-week GitHub contribution calendar. Use the directly linked project badges below the diagram to open each destination.

g.title: Portfolio system architecture
g.desc: Commitment Theory provides the conservation law; MO§ES is the shared governing execution substrate; SignalAF, AQUA and Signomy are product surfaces, with TTEOP and Upsilon supporting operator measurement.
g.text: ONE SHARED GOVERNANCE / VERIFICATION LAYER • DISTINCT PRODUCT INTERFACES
Pixel motifs adapted from the SigRank 3×3 visual language; not earned badges.
